cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: an herbal tea shop — shelves of glass tea jars, bundles of drying herbs, a copper kettle and a wooden tasting counter
cuts.scene: she is a blender sitting upright at the tasting counter, resting a moment while she thinks over the next tea mix
cuts.outfit: a tea blender look fitted to her body — a short green apron over a fitted camisole and short skirt, bare shoulders and legs, a tea infuser charm at her belt
